fields.description_2: For DCA Dienstverlening, I structured the WordPress experience around cleaning categories, specialist services, proof, practical information and quotation actions. The homepage presents the broad offer first, then separates regular cleaning, specialist cleaning and drone services so organisations can reach the relevant route. Reviews, client logos and working-method content support trust without replacing the service explanation. Quotation and contact actions stay close to the sections where a visitor is likely to decide. The same hierarchy is preserved on mobile, with service choices and calls to action easy to scan. The portfolio entry gives a clear, factual account of the actual website and current service range without adding unsupported claims about lead growth, customer satisfaction or other measured outcomes.
